text:
sophie-support: CS noticing three customers reporting intermittent 502/504 + streaming timeouts to hosted inference around 22:05 UTC. p95 spiked to ~12s, p50 ~800ms → multiple long requests dropped. customer examples and request-ids shared in thread. asking for triage and handoff.

oliver-oncall: oncall here, starting triage. any recent deploys? can someone confirm scope (hosted only / eu / apac)?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-01T21:58Z - runtime-image v2.11.0 -> ap-west/ap-east completed (2/3), canary still rolling.

matt-sre: looking at infra metrics — sudden memory RSS growth on model-worker pods serving longformer-13b-q4. several pods restarted with OOM_KILL at ~22:04. ingress queue depth increased, gateway returned 502s when backends flapped. KV cache hitrate dropped during the window.

jia-eng-runtime: runtime traces show heavy swap activity (swap-in/out) on quant allocator when sequence length > 4k. paging to disk caused tail latency spikes and eventual process OOMs. plausible regression in mem accounting after qalloc refactor last week.

kevin-product: affected models? are customers pinned to that exact model? need to scope CS comms.

sophie-support: customers affected all pinned to redwood/longformer-13b-q4 with very long context (>=6k tokens). one customer had client-side loop re-sending on 502 which amplified load.

matt-sre: immediate mitigations I can apply: 1) scale out hot pool +6 nodes (temporary), 2) increase per-pod memory limit to avoid OOM while we patch, 3) enable route fallback to 7b-quant for failing requests. recommend enabling 2 & 3 now.

oliver-oncall: doing scale and fallback now. will monitor.

oliver-oncall: scale +6 hot-nodes triggered, fallback to redwood/longformer-7b-q4 enabled for route /v1/generate with 15m TTL.

jia-eng-runtime: good short-term plan. followup: I'll prepare a canary runtime image with qalloc fix (adjust kv cache charge + avoid swap) and run canary in ap-west within 3 hours. also adding an early OOM detector to fail fast before gateway timeouts.

sophie-support: CS will send customers a short note offering temporary mitigation steps: 1) reduce max_tokens and truncate long context where possible, 2) set exponential retry + jitter (avoid immediate retry on 5xx), 3) opt into fallback route if they accept smaller model. draft: "We're aware of intermittent 502/504 and timeouts for long-context requests to longformer-13b-q4. We're actively mitigated and can enable a smaller-model fallback for your traffic while we patch the runtime. Also recommend trimming queries > 4k tokens."

kevin-product: add comms for status page and include known workaround matrix (truncate, fallback, client-retry).

matt-sre: action items: 1) keep scale/fallback for 2 hours and monitor p95, 2) rollback canary if we see regressions, 3) gather heap profiles from affected pods (I will collect), 4) postmortem doc within 48h with root cause + release notes.

jia-eng-runtime: I will cut canary image (v2.11.1-canary) with allocator fix and test under synthetic long prompts. target deploy to canary pool in 2.5h.

oliver-oncall: current status: fallback enabled, +6 nodes up, OOM restarts reduced after scale. gateway 5xx rate down to baseline. keeping war room open for at least 60m.

sophie-support: CS will update customers in 30 minutes with mitigation steps + opt-in fallback info. will log tickets for each affected customer.

matt-sre: saving logs + profiles to /incidents/1003586420/artifacts and will attach to postmortem.

jia-eng-runtime: draft PR with fix: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4237 — includes allocator charge fix + an opt-out env var to disable large-seq caching.

kevin-product: once canary proves green, schedule controlled rollout and include flag to auto-fallback on memory pressure.

oliver-oncall: summary & owners: matt-sre (infra mitigation & logs), jia-eng-runtime (runtime fix/canary), sophie-support (customer comms), kevin-product (status page + comms). closing warroom when canary is validated.

--- ACTION ITEMS (short):
- sophie-support: notify affected customers (in 30m) and add workaround text (truncate + fallback).
- matt-sre: keep scale/fallback for 2h, collect heap/oom profiles, upload artifacts.
- jia-eng-runtime: cut canary image, deploy to canary pool in 2.5h, run synthetic load tests.
- kevin-product: update status page and coord comms.
- oliver-oncall: monitor and close warroom after stability window.

closing note: no immediate rollback required; root cause seems runtime mem accounting with quant allocator + long-context usage. postmortem + timeline due in 48h. :white_check_mark:
